messages.author: 6b954402a7976243
messages.subject: can't publish to shinyapps.io
parts:
Something changed in the past day or so.  I was able to publish apps to my account with shinyapps.io, and then last night/today (9/25) for some reason publishing fails.

I made no changes to my system, and had only minor changes to the code (shiny app) from an earlier version that did publish just fine.

I get the following 'deploy tab' info in RStudio:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 218127...DONE
Deploying bundle: 996710 for application: 218127 ...
Waiting for task: 489575936
  building: Building image: 995055
  building: Installing system dependencies
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
[2017-09-25T18:55:08.414927606+0000] Execute script: packages/build/nloptr.sh
+ set -e
+ VERSION=2.4.2
+ cd /tmp
+ curl -O http://ab-initio.mit.edu/nlopt/nlopt-2.4.2.tar.gz
  % Total    % Received % Xferd  Average Speed   Time    Time     Time  Current
                                 Dload  Upload   Total   Spent    Left  Speed
100   373  100   373    0     0   6413      0 --:--:-- --:--:-- --:--:--  6431
+ tar -zxvf nlopt-2.4.2.tar.gz

gzip: stdin: not in gzip format
tar: Child returned status 1
tar: Error is not recoverable: exiting now
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 489575937 failed: Error building image: Build exited with non-zero status: 2
Execution halted



Again, I had been succesfully publishing this app (and others) and then I started getting this message.  While it seems unlikely, I'll ask ... is this a problem caused on my end?  I did try updating my RStudio (just now) but get the same message.

Thanks in advance for any help that might be available.

Cliff

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: can't publish to shinyapps.io
parts:
The download site for nlopt is notoriously unreliable.

The author of nloptr has updated the R package to bundle the source instead of downloading, and hopefully that will hit CRAN soon. In the meantime you could try installing from GitHub with devtools.

See https://github.com/jyypma/nloptr/pull/35 for some of the history.

messages.subject: Re: can't publish to shinyapps.io
parts:
Son of a gun.  I hadn't figured that the 'car' package would be the cause.  I've been using it for years.

I found another way to do what I needed, removed the car package, and now it uploads just fine.  Many thanks for the info!

B/R

Cliff

Meantime, it appears that the old nlopt download site now issues a 301 redirect to GitHub.
I have fixed our nloptr installer to follow the redirect, and deploys that include nloptr appear to be working again.
Sorry for the trouble!
